audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 was 'Skill' and Levels 2, 3 and First item were given to Yone, with 4-5 and 6 as 'Skill' — the inverse of the packet chart and of the page's own why-strings, which concede Level 1 to Yone and give Kled everything from 2 through first item.
audit.why: Kled has no level-1 answer to Mortal Steel pokes but out-bursts Yone from 2 onward; the matchup sits at 55.07% for Kled over 523 games.
audit.corrected: Level 1 to Yone; Levels 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and First item to Kled, in both layers.

audit.why: Kled: W at 2, full re-E at 3, R at 6, Eclipse. Yone: Soul Unbound rank-ups (22s down to 10s), Fate Sealed at 6 (120/100/80s), crit and on-hit items past two.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names no Yone ability (packet defect) and gives no cooldown for Soul Unbound, the ability the whole page tells you to track.
audit.why: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s — 22 seconds at rank 1, the longest window in his kit, and when it ends his spirit is forced back to his body, which is the fixed point to land Beartrap. Mortal Steel is a 4s cooldown whose third cast dashes him forward with a knockup, so the two-stack count is the tell. Spirit Cleave (14s) shields him and scales its cooldown with attack speed, so it comes back faster the more items he has.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into the cooldown, interaction and do/don't fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: The item line recommends Executioner's Calling because 'his healing fights your pattern'. Yone has no healing in his kit.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave grants a shield, not a heal, and no other Yone ability heals — Grievous Wounds does nothing against a shield.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the armour answer to a crit/on-hit duelist.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — He snaps back when it ends. Q-pull him there. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound (E), 22s at rank 1: his spirit is forced back to his body when it ends, so his return point is fixed — Beartrap him there. - Mortal Steel (Q) is 4s; two stacks make the third cast a dash and knockup. - Spirit Cleave (W), 14s, shields him and speeds up with attack speed.

edits.before: Track Yone's Soul Unbound: He snaps back when it ends. Q-pull him there. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Soul Unbound (E) is 22s at rank 1 and snaps him back to his body — that return spot is a free Beartrap. Count Mortal Steel stacks: the third cast is the dash-knockup. Spirit Cleave shields, so burst through it.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Q-pull him there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 22s at rank 1, and his body marks exactly where he returns. Trap that spot.

edits.before: That is Yone's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Two Mortal Steel stacks make the next cast a dash-knockup — step out at the second hit.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse  (burst + the all-in sustain), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps. Executioner's Calling early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse (burst + the all-in sustain), then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps early — his crit autos and Mortal Steel are physical, and Spirit Cleave shields rather than heals.

notes: Chart was inverted against the packet and the page's own why-strings for six of seven rows; flipped as matched pairs. The item line recommended anti-heal for a champion with no healing — Spirit Cleave is a shield. Two things left alone deliberately: (1) the packet levelChart says '2+ items: Skill' while whys[6], late and the 9/10 carry rating all say Yone reclaims it — the page's existing 'Yone' value agrees with the prose, so it was not touched; (2) spikes[1] is labelled '1st item' and spikes[2] 'Lvl 6', which is out of chronological order on the page, but reordering them would need a swap of two entries rather than an edit, so it is reported here instead.
